name: hyprtrails
label: Hyprtrails Motion Trails
description: Renders smooth glowing motion trail animations behind moving windows.

options.label: Trail Color
options.description: Tint and alpha color of window movement trails.

options.label: Animation Bezier
options.description: Bezier curve name used for trail fading.

options.label: History Points
options.description: Number of position history frames recorded in the trail.

options.label: History Step
options.description: Interval between recorded position history points.

options.label: Points Per Step
options.description: Interpolated curve subdivisions per history step.
